Put the compiled plugin DLL in THIS folder, named exactly:

    User.SimHubProDash.dll

(SimHub only loads plugin DLLs whose file name starts with "User.".)

How to get it:
  - Open ..\..\plugin\SimHubProDash.sln in Visual Studio 2022, Build (Release).
    The build copies User.SimHubProDash.dll here automatically AND into SimHub.
  - The one-click installer (..\Install ProDash.bat) then copies it into SimHub.
If the DLL is absent, the installer still installs the dashboards and just
skips the plugin copy.
